question: Unsa ang mga i-upload nga dokumento ug pila ang bayad para sa online Locational Clearance sa negosyo sa CPDO?
answer:
Sa online application sa Locational Clearance sa negosyo sa CPDO, ang mga dokumento na dapat i-upload sa website https://specialpermit.davaocity.gov.ph/ ay nababasa sa chunk DEV120-BB-PDF0059-C001 sa Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II.pdf. Ang mga dokumento na kinahanglan sa online application sa Locational Clearance sa negosyo sa CPDO ay:

1. Certified True Copy of Title issued by the Registry of Deeds (ROD) or show original copy of title for validation (1 photocopy) - [S3]
2. Seven (7) complete sets of Building Plans (original copy) - [S1, S4]
   a. Filled-up title blocks
   b. Signed and sealed by CE / Architect
3. Locational Clearance Application duly notarized and signed by the applicant (1 photocopy) - [S1, S4]

Ang bayad para sa online Locational Clearance sa negosyo sa CPDO, maaoy nakita sa chunk DEV120-BB-PDF0059-C001 sa Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II.pdf. Ang bayad para sa online Locational Clearance sa negosyo sa CPDO ay maaoy magpabayad sa website https://specialpermit.davaocity.gov.ph/ at mag-select ng Online Payment. Ang bayad para sa online Locational Clearance sa negosyo sa CPDO ay hindi kinahanglan nga i-specify sa inyong tanong.

ground_truth: Under CPDO Service 12, Locational Clearance for Business (Online Application via appbts.davaocity.gov.ph) evaluates land-use compatibility under the Integrated ZO 2019-2028. Requirements uploaded to the portal are: 1) Filled-up application form; 2) Affidavit of Undertaking for neighbor's consent with sketch map; 3) Homeowners Association Certificate of No Objection (if inside a subdivision); 4) Proof of business working area pictures and road access; and 5) Certificate of Actual Land Occupancy (if inside ancestral land under RA 8371). There are no direct filing fees (None), and approval or issuance of a denial letter takes 1 Day and 50 Minutes.
